verdict.rationale: Cal.com's first-party v2 REST API docs cover creating event types (lengths, custom booking fields), creating schedules and attaching them to event types via PATCH, querying available slots several ways, and creating and rescheduling regular, recurring and instant bookings. The API supports API-key and OAuth authentication with documented rate limits, and managed users let you embed scheduling in your own product without users registering on cal.com. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in production use, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).

support.subject: As a developer, a documented REST API lets me manage event types, availability, and bookings programmatically — enough to build scheduling into my own product
